> **Key takeaways**
> - Detail sells: age range, what a session looks like, what to bring.
> - Publish the schedule weeks ahead; families plan around school.
> - Make booking one step, and ask happy parents for a review.

## Why not just discount?

A discount fills one session and lowers the price families expect next time. Fill the seat with clarity instead.

## Six things that work

1. Write the listing for a parent who has never seen your studio.
2. Add photos of the space and the kit, not stock images.
3. Publish slots four to six weeks ahead; Southern California school districts publish their calendars months in advance and families plan around them.
4. Reply to messages the same day.
5. Ask for a review after a good session.
6. Keep your price and say what it includes.

## FAQ

### Should I offer a free trial class?
A trial works when it leads straight into a booked block; a standalone freebie rarely converts.

### How far ahead should I open slots?
Four to six weeks. Families book around school terms and siblings' activities.
